rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for something that is more distant.

example.english: Can you sit further over there?
example.jyutping: nei5 co5 gwo3 heoi3 jyun5 di1 laa1

rows.note: Use this for something additional or beyond what has already been mentioned.

example.english: This time, there will be a further charge.
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 jiu3 sau1 ngaak6 ngoi6 fai3 jung6

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken choice for going or extending farther in space.

example.english: Walk further away; I can't see.
example.jyutping: nei5 haang4 jyun5 di1 ngo5 tai2 m4 dou2

rows.note: Use this for a greater degree or extent, especially before an adjective such as 先進.

example.english: This new phone is further ahead technologically.
example.jyutping: ni1 bou6 san1 gei1 gang3 gaa1 sin1 zeon3

rows.note: Use this when adding another point or action beyond what has already been mentioned, rather than making a comparison.

example.english: Besides changing the time, we can further discuss the budget.
example.traditional: 除咗改時間，我哋仲可以傾吓個預算。
example.jyutping: ceoi4 zo2 goi2 si4 gaan3 ngo5 dei6 zung6 ho2 ji5 king1 haa5 go3 jyu6 syun3
